text:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem we need owners for the outstanding remediation cards. Can we split and commit ETAs? :hourglass: 
Carlos: I can pick up PMT-2897 (kv cache drop + visibility). Will add acceptance criteria and a perf run plan before EOD tomorrow.
Erin: Thanks Carlos. Please include a regression test (script + dashboard) so we can catch repeat spikes.
Carlos: Will do. Plan: baseline perf, apply tuned eviction, run canary for 24h. Acceptance: p95 < 80ms, no cache-miss spike on cold-start.
Marcus: I'll take PMT-2903 (failover automation + dry-run). ETA 5 business days. Creating the Jira now.
Marcus: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PMT-2903  initial stub with checklist. Will schedule a staging dry-run.
Liza: PMT-2911 (capacity alert thresholds) looks infra-heavy. I can review and own verification, but need eng-infra primary on the change.
Priya: RACI proposal: PMT-2897 R=Carlos, A=Priya, C=SRE, I=Oncall; PMT-2903 R=Marcus, A=Erin, C=Eng-Platform, I=PM; PMT-2911 R=Eng-Infra, A=Liza, C=Platform, I=Customers. Thoughts?
Erin: That mapping works. Can we also tag these with "postmortem-action" and add them to the remediation board? Makes audits easier.
incident-bot: Reminder: owners must add due dates to Jira within 48h.
Carlos: PMT-2897 updated with acceptance criteria + dashboard link. ETA Thu-2024-06-13. Added a monthly smoke job to the ticket.
Marcus: PMT-2903: runbook draft uploaded and rollback steps included. ETA Tue-2024-06-18. Added staged-canary checklist.
Liza: Eng-Infra confirmed primary for PMT-2911 (owner: Diego). Diego will post ETA by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: I'll run weekly triage calls for these until closure, then we'll move to monthly audits for the next quarter. I'll send calendar invites.
Erin: Also adding automated regression alerts to PMT-2897 so any spike on the 1st of the month triggers a ticket.
Carlos: Added the alert rule and linked it.
Priya: Great work. If anyone needs a handoff, ping me and I'll pair-rotate for the final rollout.
